scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Papita Vikas Yojana
description: The 'Papita Vikas Yojana' is a component of the umbrella scheme 'Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission' launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar. The scheme promotes commercial papaya cultivation across all districts of Bihar by providing financial assistance and high-quality tissue-cultured plants. It encourages inclusive participation through reserved quotas for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women farmers. Financial assistance is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), and both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible.
objectives: Promote commercial cultivation of papaya in Bihar.
Increase horticultural production and farmers' income.
Provide financial assistance for papaya cultivation.
Encourage participation of SC, ST, and women farmers.

benefits.title: Financial Assistance
benefits.description: ₹33,750 per hectare during the first year and ₹11,250 per hectare during the second year.

benefits.title: Plant Distribution
benefits.description: Supply of high-quality tissue-cultured papaya plants.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Farmer
eligibility.description: The applicant should be a farmer.

eligibility.title: Land Requirement
eligibility.description: The applicant must have agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 hectare) to a maximum of 10 acres (4 hectares).

eligibility.title: DBT Registration
eligibility.description: The applicant must be registered on the Agriculture Department DBT Portal.

registration_steps.title: Visit DBT Portal
registration_steps.description: Visit the registration page of the Agriculture DBT Portal.

registration_steps.title: Verify Aadhaar
registration_steps.description: Select Aadhaar verification mode (OTP/BIO-AUTH/IRIS), enter Aadhaar details, and authenticate.

registration_steps.title: Validate OTP
registration_steps.description: Enter the OTP received on the registered mobile number and validate it.

registration_steps.title: Farmer Registration
registration_steps.description: Confirm Kisan Credit Card details, fill farmer, land, and bank details, submit the application, validate OTP, and generate the 13-digit Registration ID.

application_steps.title: Visit Official Portal
application_steps.description: Visit the official scheme portal and click 'Proceed to Apply'.

application_steps.title: Enter Registration Number
application_steps.description: Select applicant type and enter the 13-digit DBT Registration Number.

application_steps.title: Fill Application
application_steps.description: Provide address, land details, and other required information.

application_steps.title: Submit Application
application_steps.description: Confirm the declaration, submit the application, and note the generated Application Number.

application_steps.title: Print Application
application_steps.description: Download and print the submitted application for future reference.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Details
documents_required.remarks: Aadhaar should be linked with a mobile number.

documents_required.name: Passport Size Photograph
documents_required.remarks: Required for both DBT registration and scheme application.

documents_required.name: Bank Account Details
documents_required.remarks: Required for DBT registration and benefit transfer.

documents_required.name: Land Ownership / Revenue Receipt
documents_required.remarks: If ownership details are unclear, genealogy documents must also be attached.

important_notes: Beneficiary allocation: General Category 78.56%, Scheduled Castes 20%, Scheduled Tribes 1.44%, Women 30%.
Both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible.
Non-ryot farmers must submit a valid contract form.
Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis.
Applications can be submitted only after 48 hours of successful DBT registration.
